findings.old_behavior: A valid gold-claim mapping counted as a correct semantic positive without a separate human decision that the cited direct code evidence supported the exact final sentence.
findings.trust_violation: Semantically similar prose bound to unrelated code could receive full atomic-claim semantic precision.

findings.old_behavior: Reviewer context files were not digest-bound, and placeholder reviews bypassed template and immutable-binding checks until a reviewer name was entered.
findings.trust_violation: A reviewer could work from drifted context while workspace validation reported only pending_human_review.

semantic_hit_requires: validator verdict is supported or caveated
human gold-claim mapping resolves to the frozen gold dataset
validator artifact contains at least one direct evidence ID

adversarial_cases: gold mapping with human-rejected direct code evidence
affirmative evidence decision with no validator direct evidence IDs
gold dataset digest differs from frozen protocol
gold claim references an absent code evidence span
reviewer context content drifts before reviewer placeholders are filled
workspace template digest drifts before reviewer placeholders are filled
